'''Kath shank''' was a dish made from [[Kath hound/Legends|Kath hounds]], creatures found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The [[Nova Blades]] were known to serve this dish charred.<ref name="Dantooine" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kath shank was one of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]] that players had to find on Dantooine to receive the "Dantoonian Culinarian" achievement.<ref name="Dantooine" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
